en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a grand historic city square. On the left stands an ornate neo-Renaissance city hall with domes and towers. In front of it is a busy market scene with many stalls and umbrellas, people walking, and a central monument with steps. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey traditional European buildings with shopfronts. Printed captions at the top identify the location.
